content: Authentication System Overview: Our platform uses JSON Web Tokens (JWT) for stateless session handling. Users log in with credentials and receive an Access Token (15-min TTL) and a Refresh Token (7-day TTL). Authorization headers must accompany every API request.

Session Expiration & Token Invalidation: When a user's session expires or they log out, the server places the JWT Refresh Token into a Redis blacklist. Any subsequent attempts to access protected routes will result in HTTP 401 Unauthorized, and the frontend client must redirect the user to /login.

Protected Route Guard Implementation: Next.js and React Router protected pages are wrapped with AuthGuard middleware. If access token is expired and refresh token fails validation, all in-flight requests are cancelled and local storage credentials cleared.

Subscription Billing & Refund Policy: Enterprise subscribers are eligible for a full pro-rata refund within 14 calendar days of annual renewal. Monthly plans are non-refundable after 48 hours of billing execution.
Payment Gateway Cancellation Flow: When a customer requests plan cancellation via Customer Portal, subscription status converts to pending_cancellation until current period end date.

PostgreSQL Query Performance Optimization: Slow executing SQL queries exceeding 100ms log execution plans via pg_stat_statements. Adding composite B-Tree indexes on heavily filtered columns eliminates sequential table scans.
Redis Caching Strategy: Frequently accessed user profile data is cached in Redis with a 5-minute Sliding Expiration window to alleviate primary database load.

API Rate Limiting & Token Bucket Algorithm: API Gateway enforces rate limits of 100 requests per minute per IP using a Redis-backed Token Bucket algorithm. HTTP 429 Too Many Requests response headers specify retry time.

Microservice Circuit Breaker & Resiliency: External RPC calls to payment and notification services use Resilience4j Circuit Breaker. If failure rate exceeds 50%, circuit opens immediately to prevent cascading service failure.
